gold_own_risk: high, about 30% within 12 months (vs 4% band rate); agrees with the model's flag and thinks the band understates risk
candidate_own_risk: high, roughly 30%; agrees with the model only partly, saying the filings show more risk than the numbers

key_points.point: Verdict real risk, own risk high ~30%, agrees with the model's flag but the band understates the risk

Going-concern doubt itself breaches the term-loan covenant; lenders waived it only until May 6, 2025, further waivers at lenders' sole discretion, no cure before the March 2026 10-K; waiver cost a 2% PIK fee and 6% penny warrants
Large net loss of $145.5M (28% of assets) cushioned by $88.7M of one-offs (Amazon fee, IP settlement); underlying 2024 cash loss about -$156M, so the improvement on 2023 is mostly not real
Auditor's going concern doubt, appearing for the first time (FY2023 10-K said cash was sufficient)
Debt larger than cash: $248.3M of term-loan principal and minimum return due in 1-3 years, maturity July 24, 2026, against year-end cash of $134.3M (about $94M after returning $40M to lender control)
Fewer funding options: ATM sales suspended and a formal strategic review (sale or refinancing) started
High leverage and weak liquidity: liabilities 88% of assets, equity shrunk to about $61M, current ratio 1.32
Minimum Core Assets covenant ($200M) also waived; core assets $260M, about $60M headroom; company currently in compliance
Evidence against: no missed payments or default, lender waived rather than accelerated; loan maturity July 2026 lies outside the 12-month window
Evidence against: much lower costs (operating loss cut by $161.1M), Q4 operating cash flow only about -$2.7M, asset-light business and known brand could attract a buyer

contradictions: Candidate lists 'ATM capacity $79.6M at Sep 28, 2024' as evidence against, while GOLD states the 10-K says ATM sales have been suspended, so that capacity is not usable.

Candidate's liquidity rests on cash of $99.4M at Sep 28, 2024 and about $59M usable after the $40M return; GOLD uses year-end cash of $134.3M and about $94.3M unrestricted, so the candidate's runway (about 6 to 17 months) is based on older, lower cash figures.

Candidate puts the debt at about $180M principal, while GOLD cites $248.3M of principal plus minimum return due in 1-3 years from the 10-K table; the candidate's figure leaves out the minimum guaranteed return actually owed.
extra_points_in_candidate: The 10-K explicitly names a possible U.S. Bankruptcy Code filing among outcomes.
Loan pricing of SOFR + 9.00% plus 2.5% PIK and a 1.4x-1.7x minimum guaranteed return.
A $4.0M use fee falls due on May 6, 2025 with the waiver expiry.
Picea manufacturing agreement expires on 2025-08-17 unless extended.
Gross margin of 20.9% for FY2024 and 32.2% in Q3 2024; new robot line launched in March 2025.
Operating income of about -$191.7M and operating cash flow of about -$122M without one-time items.
summary: CANDIDATE matches GOLD on the verdict (real risk, high, about 30%) and on the core drivers: the 8-week going-concern covenant waiver, the auditor's doubt, and losses propped up by $88.7M of one-offs. However, it treats the suspended ATM as available liquidity, uses stale Q3 cash instead of year-end cash, and understates the debt owed, which weakens its debt-versus-cash and funding-options picture.
